top_signals.title: Indonesia Begins Trimming Pipeline Gas Exports to Singapore
top_signals.summary: Indonesia reduced natural gas exports to neighboring Singapore from Saturday as President Prabowo Subianto seeks to shore up domestic supply and strengthen energy security for Southeast Asia’s largest economy.
